text: 乘联会最新统计数据显示，特斯拉上海超级工厂2026年9月交付新车超9.5万辆，环比增长10.7%；国内新车销量约6.5万辆，环比增长29.5%，交付量与国内销量均创下2026年新高。另外，据特斯拉方面汇总的数据，截至2026年8月，特斯拉已在韩国、澳大利亚等14个市场交付量超过2025年全年。（上证报）
text_en: The latest statistics from the China Passenger Car Association show that Tesla's Shanghai Gigafactory delivered more than 95,000 new vehicles in September 2026, up 10.7% month on month; domestic new car sales were about 65,000, up 29.5% month on month, with both deliveries and domestic sales hitting new highs for 2026. In addition, according to data compiled by Tesla, as of August 2026, Tesla had delivered more vehicles in 14 markets including South Korea and Australia than in all of 2025. (Shanghai Securities News)
